paragraph_actions.old: 795 nm design with modular fibre collimators and telescopes with two CP32/M lens plates each. Two steering mirrors per beam remain; top-flange hardware follows our existing design. Quantities are installed requirements before laboratory stock deductions.
paragraph_actions.new: 795 nm design with modular fibre collimators and telescopes with two CP32 lens plates each. Eight pedestal connections use 8-32 studs. Two steering mirrors per beam remain; top-flange hardware follows our existing design. Quantities are installed requirements before laboratory stock deductions.

paragraph_additions.after: 795 nm design with modular fibre collimators and telescopes with two CP32/M lens plates each. Two steering mirrors per beam remain; top-flange hardware follows our existing design. Quantities are installed requirements before laboratory stock deductions.
paragraph_additions.text: Assembly note: No adhesive is specified for the PBS125-to-CRM05 bond. Confirm a suitable adhesive and laboratory supply before assembly.

paragraph_additions.after: Machine both internal mount options, one of each. The four legs have different hole positions. Two identical half-rings make one complete flange clamp.
paragraph_additions.text: Assembly note: Each mirror-mount variant requires two 0.50 mm flat stop shims (four total). The shim purchase row remains omitted pending confirmation of supply; this omission does not confirm laboratory stock.

release_pending: Stop-shim supply and PBS adhesive remain disclosed assembly follow-ups; no purchase quantity or stock assumed
